column3: a floating spherical beholder with mottled purple-brown hide, one huge central eye, a fanged grin and ten writhing eyestalks each tipped with a glaring eye.
a hulking blue-skinned toadlike slaad standing upright, wide froggy mouth agape, long bone hooks jutting from the backs of its clawed hands.
a lean charcoal-black slaad with pale gray mottling and cold glowing eyes, wreathed in faint necrotic shadow, raising one clawed hand to cast.
a small floating jellyfish-like flumph with a flat pale-blue disc body, two eyestalks on top and dangling tendrils beneath, glowing a soft pastel light.
a gaunt yellow-skinned githyanki in ornate red-dragon-scale armor and a crested helm, holding a draconic staff that breathes curling flame.
a gaunt yellow-skinned githyanki knight in ornate spiked plate armor with a tall topknot, wielding a gleaming silver greatsword in a high guard.
a gaunt yellow-skinned githyanki warrior with pointed ears and a topknot, wearing segmented half-plate and drawing a curved greatsword.
a lean ascetic githzerai monk with yellow skin and a long braided topknot, in simple wrapped robes, poised in a fighting stance with glowing psionic fists.
a lean githzerai psion with yellow skin in flowing layered robes, levitating cross-legged with a shimmering violet psionic aura around its raised hands.
a lean githzerai master with a long braided beard in austere gray-and-orange robes, floating in a meditative stance surrounded by orbiting shards of rock.
a medium gray-skinned slaad with a sleek toadlike head, holding a gnarled staff in one clawed hand while the other crackles with chaotic magic.
a large green-skinned toadlike slaad with rubbery warty hide and a cruel grin, one clawed hand raised and engulfed in green flame.
a floating grell with a huge exposed pinkish brain body, a sharp hooked beak and ten long barbed tentacles dangling beneath it.
a huge ancient grick, a stone-gray wormlike body rearing up with four ridged tentacles splayed around a snapping beaked maw.
a tiny intellect devourer, a glistening pink brain scuttling on four clawed bestial legs, faint psychic ripples around it.
a fishlike kuo-toa archpriest with silvery scales and bulging eyes, in a tattered ceremonial robe and fish-skull headdress, raising a crackling scepter.
a fishlike kuo-toa monitor with bluish-gray scales and bulging eyes, in a fighting stance with webbed fists crackling with lightning.
a fishlike kuo-toa whip with greenish scales and bulging eyes, wearing shell trinkets and wielding a pincer staff.
a hunched fishlike kuo-toa with gray-green scales, huge bulging eyes and gills, holding a spear and a sticky net.
a purple-skinned mind flayer with four face tentacles in an ornate high-collared robe, holding an open spellbook while arcane runes orbit its hand.
a purple-skinned mind flayer with an octopus-like head of four writhing tentacles and white eyes, in a dark high-collared robe, reaching out with clawed fingers.
a hunched gray-skinned nothic with a single enormous glowing eye, long gangly arms and sharp claws, crouched and peering forward hungrily.
a stalactite-shaped piercer of rough gray stony shell, hanging point-down with a small fleshy underside and a hidden mouth and eyes.
a large red-skinned toadlike slaad with thick muscular limbs and long claws, crouched to leap with mouth open in a croaking roar.
a tiny slimy reddish slaad tadpole with a fat head full of needle teeth and a whipping tail, wriggling forward.
a small floating spectator, a round orb of brown-red flesh with one large central eye, a toothy mouth and four short eyestalks.
a tiny faerie dragon with violet-indigo scales and shimmering butterfly wings, a mischievous grin and a trail of sparkling motes.
a tiny young faerie dragon with bright red-orange scales and translucent butterfly wings, tumbling playfully mid-flight.
a young shadow dragon with smoky translucent black scales and wisps of darkness trailing from its wings, crouched with glowing pale eyes.
a huge shadow dragon of semi-transparent smoky black scales, wings spread and dissolving into darkness, breathing a stream of black necrotic shadow.
a small reddish-scaled winged kobold with leathery bat wings, hovering and clutching a rock to drop, with a dagger at its belt.
a birdlike aarakocra with blue-gray plumage in a light robe, hovering with outspread wings and summoning a swirling gust from a feathered staff.
a birdlike aarakocra with brown-red plumage and a sharp beak, diving with wings swept back, clutching a javelin in its talons.
a stocky dwarflike azer with bronze metallic skin and a beard and hair of living flame, hurling a ball of fire from its hands.
a large earth genie dao with rocky brown-gold skin and glittering gem-studded jewelry, its lower body a churning column of stone and sand, holding a maul.
a gargantuan towering elemental storm merging fire, water, earth and air into one roiling humanoid mass of lava, waves, stone and lightning.
a squat galeb duhr resembling a boulder with stubby stone arms and legs and a craggy face carved into its rock.
a green-scaled lizardfolk shaman adorned with bones and feathers, holding a stone-tipped staff as glowing earth runes float around it.
a tall imposing lizardfolk sovereign with dark scales and a crest, wearing a crown of bones and a feathered mantle, gripping a heavy trident.
a large blue-skinned water genie marid in flowing sea-green robes and pearls, its lower body a swirling column of water, holding a trident.
a merfolk with a shimmering teal fish tail and coral jewelry, raising a coral staff as a spiraling wave curls around it.
a small blobby brown mud mephit with stubby wings dripping sludge, a sullen face and a gloppy outstretched hand.
a serpentine fire snake with glowing red-orange scales like cooling embers, coiled and hissing with flickering flames along its spine.
a large salamander with a humanoid torso and fiery serpent tail, crimson scales and a crown of flame, wielding a white-hot spear.
a small gray smoke mephit with a sooty impish body and wings of drifting smoke, grinning and puffing a cloud of cinders.
a large serpentine water weird made of clear rippling water, rearing up with faint glowing eyes in its liquid head.
a large ancient hag with gnarled green-gray skin, long iron claws and wild white hair, wearing a crown of thorns and holding a glowing cauldron ladle.
a froglike bullywug shaman with mottled green skin, wearing reeds and a bone necklace, holding a twisted staff dripping swamp water.
a froglike bullywug warrior with mottled green-brown skin, wearing crude hide armor and a reed helm, gripping a spear.
a centaur warden with a chestnut horse body and a humanoid torso in leaf-patterned leather, drawing a longbow, antler-like crown of branches.
a huge dire worg, a monstrous black wolf with glowing yellow eyes, bristling mane and slavering jaws, snarling low.
a small green-skinned goblin hexer in a ragged hooded cloak with fetishes and bones, holding a crooked wand trailing purple hex sparks.
a red-orange-skinned hobgoblin warlord in polished black lacquered plate armor and a crested helm, raising a longsword in command.
a tiny pixie with iridescent dragonfly wings and a flower-petal crown, waving a little wand that spills rainbow sparkles.
a tiny pixie with translucent butterfly wings and a leaf dress, hovering and scattering glittering fairy dust.
a satyr with goat legs and curling ram horns, dressed in a festive vest with ribbons, playing pan pipes mid-dance.
a regal humanoid animal lord with lion-like features, a flowing golden mane and fur-trimmed mantle, surrounded by a faint radiant aura of wild beasts.
a youthful celestial titan with golden skin and radiant hair, in a white-and-gold tunic, holding a glowing small hammer.
a huge celestial titan empyrean with luminous bronze skin, in gleaming golden armor, wielding an enormous radiant maul.
a large sphinx with a lion's body, great feathered wings and a wise human face, wearing a gold headdress, surrounded by floating glowing glyphs.
a hooded cultist in tattered purple robes with eye motifs, one arm warped into a writhing tentacle, holding a ritual dagger.
a stately archpriest in ornate white-and-gold vestments and a tall mitre, raising a radiant holy symbol and a gilded staff.
a confident crime lord in a fine dark coat with a fur collar and gold rings, holding a rapier and a coin purse.
a sly bandit in a hooded patchwork cloak half-hiding the face, twirling a dagger behind the back with a smirk.
a towering berserker commander in fur and battered mail, horned helm, bellowing with a massive greataxe raised.
a cult hierophant in black-and-crimson robes and an ornate mask, raising a sacrificial staff with dark sigils floating above.
a gaunt cultist in black robes with a skull mask, holding a scythe-bladed staff wreathed in sickly green necrotic mist.
a cultist in robes split into flame, wave, stone and wind colors, holding a staff topped with a swirling elemental orb.
a cultist in red-black robes with a horned mask, clutching an infernal tome while hellfire flickers in the other hand.
a young mage apprentice in a plain blue robe and satchel of scrolls, clutching a wand that sparks a small magic missile.
a young noble prodigy in an elegant embroidered doublet and cape, poised with a slim rapier in a flawless fencing stance.
a legendary bard in a splendid plumed hat and glittering cape, playing a gilded lute that radiates golden musical notes.
a flamboyant maestro in a tailored velvet coat with a baton raised, swirling magical notes around the hand.
a cheerful traveling performer in a colorful motley outfit mid-dance, a small hand drum held high.
a pirate admiral in a long red coat with gold epaulettes and a tricorne hat, brandishing a cutlass and a flintlock pistol.
a knight errant in shining plate armor with a heraldic tabard and plumed helm, holding a longsword and a kite shield.
a scout captain in a green hooded cloak and leather armor, drawing a longbow, quiver of arrows on the back.
a shadowy spymaster in a dark hooded cloak and mask, holding a sealed letter in one hand and a hidden dagger in the other.
a battle-hardened commander in steel plate with a crimson cloak, longsword raised overhead in a rallying gesture, round shield on the arm.
a small animated broom of straw and wood standing upright on its bristles, swinging its handle like a club.
a large bull-like gorgon made of interlocking brass plates, steam venting from its nostrils as it lowers its horned head to charge.
a gargantuan bronze-and-stone colossus statue warrior with a towering helm and glowing eyes, raising a massive sword.
an animated suit of dark ornate plate armor with an empty glowing helm visor, gripping a longsword, faint arcane light inside.
a boxlike modron duodrone, a cube-shaped body with a simple face, two arms and two legs, standing stiffly.
a small spherical modron monodrone with one eye, a single arm, small wings and spindly legs, holding a dagger.
a large starfish-shaped modron pentadrone with five arms and five legs radiating from a central body with gas vents.
a cube-shaped modron quadrone with a face on each side, four arms, two legs and small wings, aiming a shortbow.
a pyramid-shaped modron tridrone with a face on its front, three arms and three legs, holding javelins.
a sinister animated scarecrow of straw and burlap with a stitched grin and glowing eyes, clawed straw hands outstretched, wearing a tattered hat.
a large floating gas spore, a gray-brown fungal sphere imitating a beholder with a false central eye and limp eyestalk-like growths.
a gargantuan twisted blight tree of black bark with a gnarled vampiric face in its trunk, red sap oozing and branches clawing outward.
a medium humanoid mushroom myconid with a broad mottled cap and pale stalk body, releasing a puff of glowing spores.
a large regal myconid with a huge purple-spotted cap like a crown, surrounded by drifting luminous spores.
a shambling corpse overgrown with fungus and mushrooms sprouting from its back and head, arms hanging limply.
a small young myconid sprout with a tiny round mushroom cap and stubby limbs, puffing a little cloud of spores.
a humanoid needle blight of twisted coniferous wood, covered in bristling needles, arms raised to fling a volley.
a huge animated tree blight, a twisted dead oak with a gaping knothole maw and grasping root-like branches.
a small crouching twig blight made of dry brittle sticks and thorns, reaching with thin clawlike twig fingers.
a humanoid tangle of creeping green vines with a leafy hood, lashing out with long whiplike tendrils.
a large hulking corpse overgrown with violet fungus, purple mushroom stalks and lashing rot tendrils sprouting from its body.
a huge one-eyed cyclops oracle in hide robes with bone charms, leaning on a gnarled staff, the single eye glowing with prophetic light.
a huge one-eyed cyclops sentry in crude bronze armor plates, gripping a massive club and a boulder.
a huge deformed fomorian giant with lopsided features, one bulging evil eye, warty skin and a crude iron club.
a large brutish ogrillon, an orc-ogre crossbreed with gray-green skin, tusks and spiked knuckles, crouched with fists raised.
a gargantuan black ooze mass with roiling glossy surface swirling into a void-like center, tendrils dissolving everything it touches.
a medium puddle of gray translucent ooze rising in a wave, faint violet psychic ripples pulsing from within.
a jackal-headed arcanaloth yugoloth with golden fur, in rich purple robes, holding a scroll with a glowing arcane sigil.
a large orangutan-like barlgura demon with reddish fur, small tusks and long powerful arms, crouched and snarling.
a cambion with crimson skin, small horns and batlike wings, in black plate armor, holding a fire-wreathed spear.
a large chasme demon resembling a giant housefly with a humanoid face, hairy legs and a long proboscis, buzzing wings.
a hyena-headed gnoll warped by demonic power, with red glowing eyes, twisted horns and cracks of fel fire in its fur.
a tall spotted gnoll with hyena head and bloodstained hide armor, wielding a triple-headed flail.
a large spotted gnoll pack lord in trophy-decorated hide armor, wielding a glaive and howling.
a huge minotaur-like goristro demon with massive horns, a bull head and hulking muscular body, charging forward.
a jackal-headed humanoid in tattered robes, with sandy fur and a scimitar, half-crouched like a lurking scavenger.
a medium wormlike larva with a pale bloated maggot body and a twisted miserable humanoid face.
a squat manes demon with gray-green flesh dissolving into foul smoky vapor, with clawed hands and a hollow mouth.
a small shambling manes demon with pallid wrinkled flesh, a paunch, sharp claws and empty eyes.
a mezzoloth yugoloth, an insectile humanoid with a chitinous body, four arms and a trident.
a large nycaloth yugoloth with green gargoyle-like skin, black batlike wings and a greataxe.
a large sahuagin baron, a sharklike fish-man with dark green scales and a fin crest, wielding a coral-encrusted trident.
a sahuagin priestess with green scales and a fin crest, wearing a shell necklace and holding a shark-tooth staff.
a shadow demon, a smoky black batlike silhouette with long claws and glowing eyes, half-dissolving into darkness.
a small spined devil with red-brown skin, bat wings and a tail covered in sharp quills, ready to fling them.
a writhing swarm of potbellied gray-green dretch demons, claws and gaping mouths jostling together.
a writhing heap of pale maggotlike larvae with tiny tormented humanoid faces.
a slumping mass of melted-flesh pale-red lemure devils oozing together with vacant faces.
a gray-skinned ultroloth yugoloth with a smooth featureless head and mesmerizing glowing eyes, in an elegant dark robe, holding a longsword.
a yochlol demon, a pillar of glistening yellow-gray slime with a single red eye and writhing tentacles.
a huge giant squid with reddish flesh, enormous eyes and long suckered tentacles curling outward.
a huge abominable yeti with shaggy white fur, icy blue eyes and enormous claws, roaring with frost breath.
a medium bulette pup, a stocky armored burrowing beast with a blue-gray shell and a toothy snapping maw.
a large carrion crawler, a segmented green worm-like creature with many legs and a pair of paralytic tentacles around its mouth.
a large cockatrice with a rooster head and red crest, scaly reptilian body and bat wings, petrifying gaze glowing.
a large black panther-like displacer beast with six legs and two whiplike tentacles ending in spiked pads, a shimmering displaced echo.
a huge flightless bird with a long axe-shaped beak and powerful legs, running forward.
a large hook horror with a vulture-like head, chitinous gray exoskeleton and long curved hooks for hands.
a kenku, a crowlike humanoid with black feathers in a tattered cloak, holding a shortsword.
a peryton with an eagle body and the head and antlers of a stag, swooping with outstretched talons.
a huge primeval owlbear with brown feathers and fur, a massive beak and claws, roaring on hind legs.
a white-furred quaggoth shaman with bone ornaments, its hands glowing with psionic light.
a white-furred, apelike quaggoth with long claws and bared fangs.
a swarm of stirges, small batlike creatures with mosquito proboscises and reddish wings.
a thri-kreen marauder, a four-armed mantis-like insectoid with green chitin, wielding a gythka polearm.
a thri-kreen psion, a four-armed mantis-like insectoid with sandy chitin, hands glowing with psychic energy.
a troglodyte, a stocky lizardlike humanoid with gray-brown scales and a crest, holding a stone club.
a large umber hulk with black chitinous armor, mandibles, four eyes and massive digging claws.
a large yeti with shaggy white fur, icy blue eyes and powerful claws, crouching to pounce.
a large young remorhaz, a centipede-like creature with icy-blue armor and glowing red-hot plates on its back.
a large yuan-ti abomination with a serpent head and humanoid arms, coiling snake body, wielding a scimitar.
a yuan-ti infiltrator in a hooded cloak, with snake-scaled skin and slitted eyes, holding a dagger.
a yuan-ti malison with a humanoid body and a snake head, in robes, holding a scimitar.
a yuan-ti malison with a humanoid body and arms replaced by writhing snakes, glaring with slitted eyes.
a yuan-ti malison with a humanoid upper body and a long snake tail, in ornate jewelry, holding a longbow.
a translucent pale-blue banshee, a ghostly elven woman with flowing hair, mouth open in a silent scream.
a large rotting beholder zombie with sagging gray flesh, a clouded central eye and limp broken eyestalks.
a large bone naga, a skeletal serpent with a human skull, glowing eyes and coiling vertebrae.
a tiny crawling claw, a severed undead hand scuttling on its fingertips with yellowed nails.
a death knight aspirant in scorched black plate armor, glowing ember eyes in a helm, holding a longsword wreathed in dark flame.
a death knight in blackened ornate plate armor with a burning skeletal face behind the visor, raising a hellfire-wreathed greatsword.
a large death tyrant, a skeletal beholder skull with a glowing central eye and floating spectral eyestalks.
a tiny demilich, a floating jewel-encrusted skull wreathed in cold green light and drifting dust.
a huge dracolich, a skeletal dragon with tattered wings and glowing blue-green eyes, rearing with jaws open.
a tiny flameskull, a floating human skull engulfed in green flames with glowing eye sockets.
a skeleton engulfed in flickering orange flames, holding a burning scimitar in a fighting stance.
a gaunt ghast in a tattered shroud, gray-green skin and long claws, raising a hand to summon grave spirits.
a huge revenant made of piled gravestones and bones, with glowing eyes and a hulking skeletal frame.
a gargantuan spectral revenant, a ghostly figure of swirling mist and chains with burning eyes.
a lacedon ghoul, a pale aquatic undead with webbed claws, sharp teeth and dripping seaweed hair.
a translucent, pale blue-white poltergeist with a twisted, grimacing wisp of a face and long clawed spectral arms, its lower body fading into swirling mist.
a revenant with decaying flesh and burning eyes, in tattered armor, clutching a longsword.
a vampire nightbringer in a dark high-collared cloak with a pale face and fangs, wreathed in shadowy mist.
a vampire umbral lord in ornate black armor and a tattered cape, crowned with shadow, wielding a dark sword.
